hunks.sol: Go Jun, who had been turning away, stopped dead.

hunks.baseline: “No, sir.”

hunks.sol: Afraid Go Jun’s anger might turn on him, the team member hurriedly continued.

hunks.baseline: “After checking, we confirmed that none of the late Vice Guild Master’s belongings have been found yet.”
hunks.sol: “We checked. None of the late Vice Guild Master’s belongings have been found yet.”

hunks.baseline: “There’s only one report I need from those bastards. A report saying they found what I need.”
hunks.sol: “There’s only one report I want from those bastards. That they found what I need.”

hunks.baseline: Go Jun’s eyes sank into darkness.

hunks.baseline: Even now, with the Crown Prince Party—closely tied to the Ares Guild—on the decline, the Ares Guild’s influence and power remained intact.

hunks.sol: Even the straightest bamboo bent beneath enough weight. Go Jun had created that weight with tens of billions of won.

hunks.sol: The head of the investigation team managing the city that had once been the Arch Lich’s stronghold, along with the senior officials under him, had proved no different.

hunks.baseline: “Tell those bastards to find it, no matter what it takes. And tell them not to contact me again until they do.”

hunks.baseline: That was how important the object he was searching for was.
hunks.sol: That was how important the object was.

hunks.baseline: Not merely because it was a keepsake of the Master he had followed like a father. It could also become a powerful weapon capable of driving someone into an inescapable corner.
hunks.sol: Not merely because it was a keepsake of the Master he had followed like a father. It could also become a powerful weapon—one capable of driving someone into a corner with no escape.

hunks.baseline: Lee Jungryong had been the true master of the immensely influential Ares Guild, and he always carried a small holographic recorder on his person in case something happened.
hunks.sol: Lee Jungryong had been the true master of the immensely influential Ares Guild. In case the unexpected ever happened, he had always carried a miniature holographic recorder on his person.

hunks.baseline: He had carried it on the day he met his death at Jin Taekyung’s hands, too.
hunks.sol: The day he died at Jin Taekyung’s hands had been no exception.

hunks.baseline: At that very moment, the flames burning in Go Jun’s eyes began to shake violently.
hunks.sol: At that moment, the fire in Go Jun’s eyes wavered violently.

hunks.baseline: Before he knew it, the face of one man—someone he hated beyond measure and feared even more—flashed before his eyes.
hunks.sol: Before he knew it, the face of the man he hated beyond measure yet feared even more flashed through his mind.

hunks.baseline: Just thinking of that name made his heart sink and his hands and feet tremble.
hunks.sol: Merely thinking the name made his heart plummet and his hands and feet tremble.

hunks.baseline: The indifferent gaze that had looked down at him beneath the faint moonlight and the dry voice that had accompanied it clouded his eyes and ears like an apparition.
hunks.sol: The indifferent eyes that had looked down at him beneath the pale moonlight and the dry voice that had accompanied them filled his senses like a waking nightmare.

hunks.baseline: The voice had burrowed into Go Jun’s ears as he howled from pain he had never imagined possible.
hunks.sol: The voice had burrowed into Go Jun’s ears while he screamed in unimaginable agony.

hunks.baseline: *Let Lee Jungryong be the end of it. Hide your teeth and put away your claws. If you do that… nothing will happen.*
hunks.sol: *Let it end with Lee Jungryong. Hide your teeth and put away your claws. If you do that… nothing will happen.*

hunks.baseline: Every bone in his body had been crushed like matchsticks, and his living flesh had been torn away as though it were being wrung out. He had been forced to struggle in a bottomless swamp of pain without ever managing to swing his weapon properly.
hunks.sol: Every bone in his body had been crushed like matchsticks, and his raw flesh had been torn away as though wrung from his body. Without even getting the chance to wield his weapon properly, he had been left thrashing in an endless swamp of pain.
Lee Jungryong had been an insurmountable wall and a Master Go Jun revered.

hunks.baseline: If Lee Jungryong had been a wall Go Jun could never cross and a Master he revered, Jin Taekyung was something no one had ever seen before.
hunks.sol: Jin Taekyung was something no one had ever seen before.
